verdict.rationale: The pack documents data-retention controls: a default 30-day retention and a self-serve Zero Data Retention toggle under which prompts and outputs are never persisted to disk. No item says whether customer data is used for model training or offers a training opt-out, and retention is a related but different control, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
